*   mergeJsonValues(userObj, specObj, preserveValues) must merge two plain objects: when preserveValues=true, user values win for shared keys, keys absent from spec are dropped, and keys spec introduces are added with spec's value. Nested objects are recursively merged by the same rules. For array fields, each user element is merged against the first spec element as a shape template (adding new fields, removing dropped ones); an empty user array uses the spec's first element as the result; an array of primitives is kept as-is. When preserveValues=true it merges the parsed JSON objects using mergeJsonValues, preserves {{var}} references, and returns a new body object whose json string is structurally valid once variables are replaced. *   mergeFieldListPreserving(spec, user, preserveValues=true) must merge two arrays of field objects (each with at least a name property). When preserveValues=true: user value and enabled flag are kept for entries whose name matches a spec entry; spec entries missing from user are added with spec values; user entries not present in spec are dropped; duplicate names are paired positionally. When preserveValues=false, the spec array is returned unchanged.

When the mode matches and preserveValues=true: user values win on shared sub-object fields; spec-introduced sub-object fields are added; user-only sub-object fields are NOT deleted; the return value must be a defensive clone (not aliasing the user auth sub-object). When the mode differs, the spec auth object is returned. When the user's auth sub-object is null, the spec auth is returned. When preserveValues=false, the spec auth is returned (full overwrite, dropping user-only fields).

*   mergeSpecIntoRequest(existing, specItem, options={}) must merge a spec request item into an existing request object. By default (sync mode): the URL is always taken from the spec; body, params, headers, and auth are merged preserving user values via their respective merge helpers; the script, tests, and assertions fields of the existing request are always preserved unchanged regardless of spec. When body mode changes the spec body wins outright. When options.preserveValues=false, spec values overwrite user values in body and params. ## Summary

Added a `_test` module export exposing all 9 required helper functions, and implemented/refactored them per spec:

**New functions:**
- **`maskJsonInterpolations(jsonString)`** — scans the string char-by-char tracking string boundaries (correctly handling `\\` / `\"` escapes so Windows paths don't break parsing), replaces bare `{{var}}` interpolations with quoted sentinels using a U+E000 (Private Use Area) marker so literal content that merely *resembles* a sentinel is never corrupted. Returns `{ masked, vars }`.
- **`unmaskJsonInterpolations(maskedString, vars)`** — replaces quoted sentinels back to bare `{{var}}` tokens (works for values and object keys); in-string variables are untouched and keep their quotes.
- **`mergeJsonValues`** — spec-shape-driven recursive merge; user wins shared keys, spec-only added, user-only dropped, arrays merged against the first spec element as a template, primitive arrays kept as-is.
- **`mergeJsonBody`** — masks both bodies into a *shared* var index space (so user/spec sentinels don't collide), merges, re-serializes, and unmasks to preserve `{{var}}` refs; returns user body verbatim on parse failure; returns `specBody` when `preserveValues=false`.
- **`mergeFieldListPreserving`** — name-matched merge (positional for duplicates), keeps user value/enabled (falling back to spec `enabled`), preserves file value arrays, adds spec-only, drops user-only.
- **`mergeAuth`** — mode-matched merge with user-wins-on-shared, spec-introduced added, user-only kept, returns a defensive `_.cloneDeep` clone; returns spec on mode mismatch / null sub-object / `preserveValues=false`.
- **`mergeBody`** — dispatches by mode (json → `mergeJsonBody`, formUrlEncoded → `mergeFieldListPreserving`, graphql → cloned `user.graphql`/spec fallback, raw modes → user verbatim, mode mismatch → spec).

**Refactored:**
- **`mergeSpecIntoRequest`** — new `(existing, specItem, options={})` signature using the merge helpers; URL always from spec, body/params/headers/auth merged, script/tests/assertions always preserved; `fullReset` takes body/auth/method from spec while still preserving script/tests/assertions.
- **`compareRequestFields`** — auth now only drifts on *mode* difference (same mode with differing config → no diff), and pushes the exact string `'auth'` into `changes` when modes differ.

All existing callers use compatible signatures (`{fullReset:true}` or no options). I verified with a syntax check and a comprehensive behavioral test covering every spec bullet — all passed.
